invariants.rationale: Method always returns the result of execute(), which should not be null.
preppedRecords is passed directly to the commit action executor which likely does not support null as a valid value.
A non-null instantTime is typically required for commit operations in Hoodie.
Context is cast and used in the commit action; casting implies it is not null.
Method signature and returned value ensure that result implements HoodieWriteMetadata.
